definition.name: Under-5 primary-source catalyst hunter (FDA designation or positive topline 8-K), clean supply, hold 10 / stop 25%
definition.rule: Raw close 1-5 USD on the signal session t, 20-day average traded value >= 1M USD. Signal: an 8-K public in session t whose text contains an FDA designation phrase (Breakthrough Device/Therapy, Fast Track, Orphan Drug, Rare Pediatric Disease designation) [type A], or a positive-topline / primary-endpoint-met phrase in an 8-K carrying item 8.01 or 2.02 [type C]. Exclude: reverse split in the 60 days before t; 424B5 / S-1 / S-1/A / S-3 / S-3/A public in sessions t-19..t; any close-to-close move of 15%+ (either way) in t-21..t-1; already up 40%+ on the prior close when public (open for a pre-open filing, close for a filing in the session). Buy t+1 open; sell at the close of session 10 (entry day = 1) or a 25% stop under the fill.

definition.name: R&D-heavy compounder with rising margins
definition.short: R&D 10%+ of revenue, revenue +15%+, gross AND operating margin up on a year earlier; hold 12 months, 35% stop, trail after +100%
definition.rule: Monthly: TTM R&D / TTM revenue >= 10%; TTM revenue growth >= 15%; TTM gross margin above a year earlier; TTM operating margin (OperatingIncomeLoss / revenue) above a year earlier. Buy every match. PLAN G: 1 unit at the next open; sell at the next open after a close at which the position is worth <= 65% of the money in (35% disaster stop); once a close has put it at +100% or more, sell at the next open after a close under its 50-session average; else sell at the close of session 252.

definition.name: Growth leader at a new high
definition.short: revenue +30%+ and accelerating, gross margin rising, within 5% of the 52-week high; hold 12 months, 35% disaster stop, 50-day trail after +100%
definition.rule: Monthly: TTM revenue growth >= 30%; latest quarter YoY growth above the prior quarter YoY growth; TTM gross margin above the TTM a year earlier; close >= 95% of the 52-week high. Buy every match. PLAN G: 1 unit at the next open; sell at the next open after a close at which the position is worth <= 65% of the money in (35% disaster stop); once a close has put it at +100% or more, sell at the next open after a close under its 50-session average; else sell at the close of session 252.

definition.name: Novy-Marx profitable value (gross profit / assets rank + book / market rank, 50 of the 500 largest, quarterly)

source.who: Robert Novy-Marx (2013) The other side of value: the gross profitability premium, JFE 108(1) (Alpha Architect summary)
source.claim: profitability 0.31%/month, value 0.41%/month, combined 0.71%/month long-short 1962-2010 (Sharpe 0.85); works "even among the largest, most liquid stocks"
source.oos: later: value lost ~60% 2017-2020 while profitability held; the library's all-stock ANOM-GP was rejected

definition.rule: Quarterly review. Universe: the 500 largest, financials out. GP/A = TTM gross profit (or revenue - cost of revenue) / latest total assets; B/M = latest stockholders' equity / market value; both known and equity > 0. Score = percentile rank of GP/A + percentile rank of B/M (each 0..1 within the eligible set); hold the 50 highest (ties: higher GP/A), equal weight; sold when no longer among the 50.
definition.deviations: Long only (the paper is long-short); quarterly instead of annual / monthly; a fixed 50 instead of the top tercile / decile.

SQ16-GPVAL.rebalance: Quarterly; sell when absent from top50, not a fixed252-day holding.
